reader.execution: verified frozen feature cache; no Reader loading

training.order: immutable source order; no shuffling or checkpoint selection

gates.utility: quantum_membership minus Reader positive mean>0 and paired CI95 lower>0; direct mean>=0
gates.quantum_attribution: quantum_membership minus classical_membership positive mean>0 and paired CI95 lower>0
gates.training_safe_rescue: final fixed epoch quantum_membership rescues>0 and lost_protected=0; engineering gate, no adaptive early stopping
gates.stop: No scale-up if utility/direct protection or training-safe-rescue fails; attribution remains separate; structural integrity failure aborts handoff

capture.values: complete detached coordinates, initial/final head buffers, theta, raw/clipped gradients, native AdamW states and pre/post outputs

limitations: Fixed exposed100 panel remains L0, not full-data L1/L2
Loss repair is not quantum novelty or quantum advantage
Original executed runner provenance is missing; cached feature and score replay do not restore it
No new generations; upstream case input remains the content source
CPU default; exact simulated quantum/classical circuits share capacity and budget
